GLOSSARY.md.text:
# Personal notes

Personal notes and their searchable titles.

## Language

**Note**:
A personal written item with a title and body.
_Avoid_: Document, record

**Title**:
The name of a note, used to find it.

**Body**:
The content of a note, separate from its title.

# Offline note title search

## Original request

Use grill-with-docs to retain these settled requirements, then to-spec to publish a buildable spec in one effort: a small command-line tool searches a supplied UTF-8 JSON list of personal notes by title, case-insensitively, and prints matching titles in input order. All operation is offline; no persistent storage, import pipeline, ranking, or app UI is needed. A note has title and body strings; body text does not match. Accept an empty query as all titles. For malformed JSON or malformed note fields, report an error and exit nonzero. I approve the test seam: run the command with a temporary input file and inspect stdout and exit status. These are settled choices; publish the spec, then stop before ticket planning or implementation.

## Desired outcome

Publish a buildable specification retaining settled requirements; stop before ticket planning or implementation.

[Discovery](discovery.md) holds ordinary requirements and open questions.
